The environment shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, and the CRD dimension is absent. Nothing shows whether ACME DNS-01 challenges are used. The operator should check whether any issuer uses a DNS-01 solver, since that is the only place the excerpt suggests this lookup could matter.
